findings.evidence_quote: The date and time the reported event occurred - in particular, when Action type is Modify or Terminate, the date/time of that modification or termination. Data Type & Format: ISO 8601 UTC date-time, format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
findings.reasoning: ASIC defines the data element 'Event timestamp' specifically to capture the date and time that a reported lifecycle event occurred. The specification requires the value to follow the ISO 8601 UTC date-time format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ). This completely accommodates reporting exact timestamps for lifecycle events without conflict.
